99003.description:
Amamiya Hiroto is unlucky. His life consisted of misfortune after misfortune, culminating in an unlucky death during an incident on a school boat trip, trying to save a girl he barely knew. After death, he met a god of reincarnation who requested that the hundred or so dead passengers—one of them being the girl he tried in vain to save—be reincarnated into another world. Yet a series of unfortunate events forced Hiroto to reincarnate with even less luck than before, starting with nothing but a tremendous amount of Mana. His second life, far worse than his first, came to a cruel end. However, upon meeting the god a second time, he was informed that there would be yet another reincarnation—one that had already been set in motion and could not be stopped. Not wanting Hiroto to endure a third life filled with suffering, the god cursed him before he was reborn in the hopes that he would either die quickly or commit suicide. Hiroto was reborn once more as a half-vampire, half-dark elf. A dhampir. Not wanting a fourth life, he is determined to live this third life with the only things remaining from his previous lives—Death Magic and his enormous Mana pool.

(Source: Light Novel Bastion)
synonyms: The Death Mage that doesn't want a fourth time
อมเวทแห่งศาสตร์ความตายผู้ไม่อยากมีชีวิตที่สี่

title.native: 四度目は嫌な死属性魔術師
title.romaji: Yondome wa Iyana Shi Zokusei Majutsushi

99004.description:
Tetsuya reunites with his older sister after their mother passes away.

Source: MU
synonyms: A Meek Little Brother Like Me

title.romaji: Boku no You ni Juujun na Otouto

99005.description:
Chrissy—Chrysanthemum—Han met the love of her life as she hit rock bottom. Her boyfriend cheated with another woman and, worst of all, she was cute! When the other woman decides to pay off the debt of Chrissy's ex boyfriend, Chrissy can't help but slowly fall for her. Can a love like this last or will she wish she was gone like all the rest?
(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: It'd be Great if You Didn't Exist!

99006.description:
Jisatsuya - merchants who deal with anything related to suicide, from prevention to cleaning up afterwards. There's a rumor that they also assist people in committing suicide, but the truth behind that is known only to the Jisatsuya themselves. This is their story.

Source: Manga Updates

99007.description:
A series of mysterious murders without injury are happening in Tokyo, how will Kumoi Soutarou react to them?

A Oneshot from Miracle Jump!

99009.description: A young boy inherits an old house, but it's not without a previous tenant.

99010.description: A story about a young ghost girl and a single traveler.

99011.description: Tsubaki Nishiyama, who manages an order-made shoe workshop, worked hard to be trusted by everybody. But she realized that she was now thirty years old, and her love had been rejected. Yes, this is the forked road of her life… Master Tsubaki, in the alleyway of Kyoto, will work hard on both her job, and her love!

99013.description:
From Manga at the End of the Time:

Done by the mangaka Coolkyou Shinjya, it’s about a world where anthropomorphic animals called Anthros, humans and witches are at war with each other. A witch named Ronya is on the run from a soldier assault where she makes contact with a White Rabbit Anthro by the name of Frau Rabbit accompanied by Miss Karrot. Feeling troubled by the events before them, will these 3 be able to help the humans, witches and Anthros work out their racial differences?

99014.description: About a girl who falls in love with her best friend's mother.

title.native: リリー・マルガリーテとかすみ草

99015.description:
Kei and Mizuki's quiet lives together in the countryside are shattered when Mizuki collapses and a parasitic plant-like organism is discovered spreading its roots through her body, leeching away her life. How will Kei and Mizuki spend their last days together?

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)

99016.description: After a bad experience, Shizuku doesn't want to be involved in any love matters, however one day she bumps into a handsome man that was in a middle of an argument with a girl. She sees love as troublesome, but why is she drawn to him?

title.native: 夢など見てはおりません

99017.description:
Two sisters sign up for a dating website under pseudonyms. They mesh well together and meet up for a date where they discover that the person they were flirting with online was their sister and that sister was a lesbian. They decide to go on their date anyway...

Note: The main story concludes at chapter 10. Includes chapters 10.01-10.10
11-12: Dame na senpai × dekiru kouhai
13: Acchan to Kasumi
synonyms: Met My Sister On A Dating Site
A Story About Meeting My Sister on a Dating Site
出会い系サイトで妹と出会う話－333日目－

title.native: 出会い系サイトで妹と出会う話
title.romaji: Deai-kei Site de Imouto to Deau Hanashi

99018.description:
The story of two immortal children, beginning at the time in which everything has ended. The innocent older sister π that loves to rap, and the introverted younger brother Makki that you can always find reading alone.

The tankoubon chapters are compilated arcs of chapters in the original web release:

Volume One:
Pai - Chapters 1-5
Mira 1 - Chapters 6-7
Volume Two:
Mira 2 - Chapters 8-13
Makki - Chapters 14 Part 1 & Chapter 14 Part 2
99018.hashtag: #銀河の死なない子供たちへ
synonyms: For Immortal Children in the Galaxy

title.native: 銀河の死なない子供たちへ

99019.description:
Rena and Yuna have been roommates since school, and decided to rent a place together after graduation. They’ve lived together as friends for five years, but things suddenly change the day Yuna adopts a kitten, even though their apartment doesn’t allow pets. When Yuna says she wants to move somewhere that will allow them to keep the kitten, Rena admits her true feelings: she wants to be more than friends. Yuna isn’t sure how to reciprocate, but she’s game to try!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 私の可愛い子猫ちゃん

99020.description:
Everyone in their First Year of Junior High School little by little are becoming adults. However, Akane Mizutani still finds difficulties in changing into a grownup. One day, she meets Tsukino Tooru, who has strange, mysterious rumors surrounding him for someone appearing harmless.

With their encounter, Mizutani finds out the truth of Tsukino and another odd girl, Hiki. With Mizutani and Tsukino forming a promise to meet at the schoolyard every Monday night, the story depicts the relationship and encounters with each and one another.

99021.description: Honjo Maki is a scenario writer for a game company. One night, while going home from work, she almost ran over a girl. By the end of the night, the mysterious girl writes a time and place on Maki's hand. It turns out that it's the venue for the concert of the band Liberty.

99022.description:
Maomao, a young woman trained in the art of herbal medicine, is forced to work as a lowly servant in the inner palace. Though she yearns for life outside its perfumed halls, she isn’t long for a life of drudgery! Using her wits to break a “curse” afflicting the imperial heirs, Maomao attracts the attentions of the handsome eunuch Jinshi and is promoted to attendant food taster. But Jinshi has other plans for the erstwhile apothecary, and soon Maomao is back to brewing potions and…solving mysteries?!

(Source: Square Enix)

Note: Won the Grand Prize in the Printed Manga category at the Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Award 2019.
synonyms: ตำรับปริศนา หมอยาแห่งวังหลัง

99023.description:
Shirakaba Yuki is a girl with the Catulus syndrome, which afflicts her with cat ears and a tail, plus some behavior like a cat. In the middle of her high school entrance ceremony, Ayano Riko - who is also a first year - comes in with a mountain of cats on her back. Apparently she's a cat magnet.

They become friends.

title.native: 猫娘症候群(かとるすしんどろーむ)

99024.description:
It’s time to change the misguided medical care in another world by using modern pharmacy!

When a young pharmacologist gives his life to his research and dies from overwork, he finds himself reincarnated as a boy named Farma, the son of the court physician. In a new world where faulty remedies run rampant, Farma uses modern pharmacy and cheat powers to cure all the diseases around him.

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: เภสัชกรเทพสองโลก

99025.description:
Hatsune Miku and her friends Rin, Len, and Luka are not only back in manga... they're back to school, enrolling at the St. Diva Academy for Vocaloids! They're going to give it their best at St. Diva, as a wonderland of friendship, determination, and even love unfolds! But can they stay out of trouble, especially when the mad professor of the Hachune Miku Research Lab is nearby?

(Source: Dark Horse)

99026.description:
In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there.
Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: สืบคดีปริศนา หมอยาตำรับโคมแดง

99027.description:
High school student Yaneko loves to sleep, so much that she can barely wake up of her own accord. That is, until she is roused from her slumber by a sleep spirit known as Nerim. Yaneko must accompany the benevolent spirit on his daily work route, as he grants the gift of comfortable sleep to people (and animals!) of all ages. But just what is his true purpose and why has he chosen Yaneko to be his assistant? This could very well be the beginning of a beautiful friendship!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

99028.description:
Pretty Angel Nirvana was everyone's favorite magical girl, and her TV show was watched in every home. But when an office worker's computer goes on the fritz, it brings the once fictional heroine out of the screen and into our world! Can this magical girl deal with the unmagical realities of everyday life? Find out what happens when a magical girl is asked to set aside her wand and stop fighting monsters to tackle grocery shopping and paying bills!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Series contained 30 chapters but only 20 were collected in the two volumes.
synonyms: "Sad News" The Later Daily Life of the Magic Girl

title.native: 【悲報】魔法少女のその後の日常。
title.romaji: "Hihou" Mahou Shoujo no Sonogo no Nichijou.

99029.description: The irascible incarnation of the shuuden (last train of the night) guides drunkards home.

99030.description:
A photograph with a disappeared girl and a mysterious shadow. Hitoka Yanagi asks her classmate Mao Moriya, a girl who solves supernatural cases for money, to help investigate the hidden mysteries.

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.english: Reikan Shoujo wa Hako no Naka
title.romaji: Reikan Shoujo wa Hako no Naka

99032.description:
This is my first time seeing a penis like this! A traveling penis dreams, gets hurt, and warms up to human kindness. A whimsical, heartwarming, and lyrical story.

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

99033.description:
Summer, ghosts, and my feelings for you.

Yamano is a second-year high schooler in love.
One day, out of nowhere, the very object of his affection, Tanigawa-san, appeared in front of him. As a ghost.
It seems that she died after being involved in some kind of incident.

To save Tanigawa from death, Yamano gets busy trying to change her future, but—…
A vague and fleeting youthful mystery.
synonyms: In the Summer When You Die

title.native: 無重力コミュニケイション
テラフォーマーズ THE OUTER MISSION
ノウ無し転生王の双界制覇〈ブラックアーツ〉
オーガバスター・オーバードライブ

99039.description: Kiryuin Hanao is the idol of her school and her childhood friend Takezou Watanabe is always by her side, helping her throughout her activities. But when she suddenly becomes a giantess, she is forced to return to her old ways in order to protect the city and her friends. However, it soon becomes apparent that Kiryuin is not the only girl to be afflicted with a sudden change in stature...

99040.description:
The literature industry is suffering from the publishing recession. While the literary magazine 'Mokuren' was grieving over the present state of affairs, a composition intended for their Newcomer's Award was sent to their editing department. However, it completely ignored the application rules. It should have been torn to shreds, but the work caught the eye of a sole editor. As a result, the world began to change.


Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

99041.description:
Mahoro Harukana moves to Tokio to achieve the dream of becoming an Idol. In order to do this, Mahoro will assist to the National Entretainment and Music School in Kamisaka. Everything goes surprisinly well, being great at singing and dancing, and even her teammates are astonished by her talent.

The only problem is that... Mahoro is actually a boy, and a boy who wants to become The King of the Idols!

title.native: キング・オブ・アイドル

99042.description: A girl with prosthetic limbs and a tragic past wanders a zombie-ridden 23rd century earth now known as Death’s Amusement Park. Overrun by monsters, the post apocalyptic wasteland is the last place a little girl should call home, but she’s developed a unique coping mechanism...

title.native: ソウルリキッドチェインバーズ
火ノ丸相撲 四十八手

99044.description:
Rampage. Weep. Kill. Every 12 years, the 12 signs of the Chinese zodiac take the form of warriors and engage in the ultimate battle royal. They face one another in battles to the death, using all the powers of their star signs, and the sole survivor is granted the ultimate prize—a wish. Any wish.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.romaji: Koi no Hanashi wo, Shiyou ka

99046.description: Ended with the cancellation of the publication of Dengeki Daioh Genesis at the 6th volume.

title.native: デュランダル 不朽の刃

99047.description:
A compilation artbook/manga anthology, by Range Murata, with contributions by various artists.

The title aims to harness talents from global creative hotbeds like London, Paris and New York and create something more than the average manga artbook through collaborations with American and European creatives.
Every issue will reveal the huge variety of talent the Japanese illustration and manga worlds have to offer, giving insight into their work and thought processes through various features.

99048.description:
Mashiro lives on an island surrounded by sea. One day, A glittering young boy come from Tokyo and the love has begins...?

(Source: Chibi Manga)
synonyms: 戀愛來臨時是全彩～一切和你開始～

title.native: 恋降るカラフル～ぜんぶキミとはじめて～
title.romaji: Koi Furu Colorful: Zenbu Kimi to Hajimete

99049.description:
Tsuyoshi Mukouda was nothing special in modern Japan, so when he was summoned to a world of swordplay and sorcery, he thought he was ready for the adventure of a lifetime. Too bad the kingdom that summoned him only got him by mistake! Not only was he not one of the three summoned heroes, but his stats were laughable compared to theirs.

On top of that, there's something really sketchy about this kingdom... "Ah, these people are the kind to try and use the Hero," he realized, and immediately left to make his own way in this other world. The only thing Mukouda can rely on is his unique skill: the "Online Supermarket," a skill that allows him to buy modern goods in a fantasy world. It's useless for combat, but if he plays his cards right, he could lead a comfortable life, maybe? At least, that's what Mukouda thinks, but it turns out modern food bought with this skill has some absurd effects!

What happens when Mukouda introduces ridiculously tasty modern cooking to a fantasy world like this? He gets some ridiculous repeat customers begging for more...!

(Source: J-Novel Club, edited)
synonyms: Regarding the Display of an Outrageous Skill Which Has Incredible Powers
สกิลสุดพิสดารกับมื้ออาหารในต่างโลก
擁有超常技能的異世界流浪美食家

title.english: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
title.native: とんでもスキルで異世界放浪メシ
title.romaji: Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi

99051.description:
Love is the new kid on the block when he runs into the Peach Club, the local gang. Simple and gentle, with an interest in sex toys, Love isn't looking for trouble. Too bad the gang's got plans for him. And so does their leader, Peach.

(Source: Lezhin)

99052.description: Han Yu-Na gave up being a girl, but secretly loves girly things. When a big misunderstanding happened during an encounter with Lee Yu-Na, something brand new is born...

99053.description:
The world is in devastation! Humanity is forced to live in domes to survive, with the elite living in the inner dome working in the animation industry, and the general masses forced to live in the outer dome, doing various jobs. The dome is masqueraded as an anime funland. The MC is a jaded man who works in the outer dome.

The dome then receives a message from "Earth", and are then visited by aliens who look like cute girls. They introduce themselves as the "planets", with each girl having their own orbiting moon(s) (think of the microbes from Moyashimon). They state that they're here to help fix Earth's pollution, but they seem to prefer slacking off.

99057.description: About a vampire with peculiar taste.

99058.description: The story of angels who don't behave like angels and devils who are kinder than them. A new romance begins!

title.native: ハンサム彼氏〜学園の王子様〜

99061.description:
Fuyunosuke’s been living the good life in Tokyo. In fact, he’s almost got the whole “being human” thing down. His brother Natsutaro, on the other hand, can’t figure out the first thing about blending in on this strange planet. There’s still a lot they don’t know about humans, but with any luck, Fuyunosuke might just be able to show his bro that life on this little blue ball isn’t so bad after all.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: トーキョーエイリアンブラザーズ

99062.description:
The manga centers on Kiyotaka Saitou—an apathetic college student who does things at his own pace—and Todoroki, a poker-faced cool yakuza member. Kiyotaka and Todoroki were classmates in high school, and both men attend an unofficial driving school one summer thanks to a certain incident.

(Source: Anime News Network)

99063.description:
A collection of oneshots.

1. Beer-juu (ビール獣)
2. Fellowship
3. Nankin (なんきん)
4. Ani, Rashiku. (兄、らしく)
5. Swan (スワン)
6. Oheyasagashi (お部屋探し)
7. Taifu no Hi (台風の日)
synonyms: Typhoon's Day: Shinzo Keigo Short Stories

title.native: 台風の日 真造圭伍短編集
title.romaji: Taifuu no Hi: Shinzou Keigo Tanpenshuu

99064.description:
A noble vampire prince falls for a menial human blood servant... from refusal to acceptance, she begins to worry about him and solve problems for him... However, there are gaps of status, classes and hatred between them, in this confrontation between vampires and humans, will they finally break the rule and be together?

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Includes 5 prologues, 7 extra, and 11 side story chapters
synonyms: รอยกัดหวานละมุน

99065.description:
In this action-packed dark fantasy, humanity lives under the threat of annihilation by immensely powerful dragons. The dragon hunter Ragna embarks on a revenge-fueled quest to eliminate that threat once and for all!

(Source: Square Enix)
synonyms: ตำนานนักล่ามังกร

99066.description:
An eclectic collection of oneshots from Amano Shuninta.

1. Shiromuchi (しろむち); Super Comic City 21, COMITIA100 (2012)
2. Mamamama (まままま); COMITIA108 (2014)
Two women spend the morning taking care of their children.
3. Kemo Lily JK (ケモ百合JK); Comic Market 81 (2011)
4. Akazukin (赤ずきん); Comic Market 83 (2012)
Little Red Riding Hood is taking a trip through the woods to her grandmother's house, what happens after that is completely different than the versions you've heard before...
5. Around Thirty OL ga, Pool de. (In the Pool, OLs Around Thirty) (アラサーOLが、プールで。); Girls Love Festival 8 (2012)
Two OLs around thirty sit in a pool an a hot day.
6. Iraira My Wife (My Irritated Wife) (イライラマイ・ウイフ); LILYCA 2012-Winter
A dog girl is worried over her (cat girl) wife's behavior.
7. Sexy Kintarou (セクシー金太郎); kakioroshi

99068.description: A dog girl is worried over her (cat girl) wife's behavior.

99069.description:
A young and broke man, Yang Jinghua, finds himself 10 years younger after waking up from a traffic accident. Just as he is dreaming about it being a rebirth after death and that he will soon reach the peak of his life, a handsome white-haired man who calls himself the “Spirit Cleanser” appears in front of him. After this man tells Yang Jinghua “You are already dead”, he proposes a weird offer: “Boy, do you want to make a pact with me?” Gradually, a deep relationship is developed between these two men and they support each other on their journey.

(Source: Webnovel)

99071.description:
Sakichi sees his peaceful summer onstructed by a girl from the Edo period who assures that he's the reincarnation of his late lover.

Oneshot published under the label STUDIO MEN alongside with Majo wa Houki de Sora o Tobu.
synonyms: Inscrutable and interesting are the ways people are brought together

title.native: 縁は異なもの味なもの
title.romaji: En wa Inamono Aji na Mono

99075.description: A story about a girl's short-lived quest to become more interesting in order to catch her crush's attention.
synonyms: Matsumoto Eiko Is An Average Girl

title.native: 松本エーコは普通の子
title.romaji: Matsumoto Eiko wa Futsuu no Ko

99076.description: Spring has arrived. Having just turned 13, the young witch Koharu has embarked on the traditional journey of independence. Now, she just needs someplace to crash.

99077.description: Venturing into the hills to find her dog who ran away, Hitomi finds a strange lizard girl who is feeling lonely.

99078.description:
A cute love story between a track runner and an older librarian.

Extra: My Girlfriend Is a Step Ahead of Me

title.native: アオハル・ラニングス

99082.description:
Contains:

Hita-Hita (ひたひた); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol.2~16, Rakuen Web Zoukan
Imari likes cats. She loves cats! She also loves doing nothing. Like cats. So cats love her back.

La Pomme Prisonnière (ポム・プリゾニエール); Vol.16, kakioroshi

title.native: ポム・プリゾニエール

99086.description:
A story about a maid with animal ears and her mistress.

Note: Includes the side story "Goshujinsama to Aki no Hi".
synonyms: Goshujinsama to Kemonomimi no Shoujo Mel
บันทึกของนายท่านกับเมลตัวน้อย

title.native: ご主人様と獣耳の少女メル
title.romaji: Goshujin-sama to Kemonomimi no Shoujo Meru

99087.description:
Seoha, an abandoned child, whose relatives gave up on him after he lost his family. An uncle who is unable to forget his wife and their unborn child.

Their growth as the two of them wander through the snowy winter.

99089.description:
"Reach out your hand, and your story will begin!"

Those words changed young Atsuko "Akko" Kagari forever, sparking in her a lifelong dream of becoming a real witch. Now she's been accepted to the same school as her childhood hero, Shiny Chariot-the prestigious Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy. As the only student to come from a non-magical family, Akko finds herself surrounded by prodigies from around the world, but giving up isn't in her vocabulary. Whether it's making friends, proving the doubters wrong, or just flying on a broom, Akko is going to make her fantasy a reality!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: リトルウィッチアカデミア

99090.description:
Jiang Hao Yi, a high school freshman accidentally becomes the object of affection for the school's most popular girls after mistakenly sharing a chocolate cake that belongs to the god of love with them. With a magical love spell at play, Jiang Hao Yi finds himself juggling the affections of the school belle Zitong Xia, childhood friend Xueli Ouyang, athletic team leader Xuan Tang, and straight-A student Yuan Lin.

(Source: WebComics)

99091.description: In Eastern History, humans and spirits exist in this world. Fox spirits have long acted as matchmakers, holding a prestigious position among spirits. In this story, the lives of a fox spirit and a man who have both rejected the idea of true love become intertwined, and their exciting adventure begins.

99092.description: A dejected newbie writer not only gets to live in a luxury apartment for free but more importantly, his landlord is drop dead gorgeous! But why does he like to inappropriately touch people? Could he possibly be...?
synonyms: So My Landlord Is a Hottie

title.romaji: Yuan Lai Fangdong Chao Shuai De!

99093.description:
It's an everyday life of a shy girl called Tomoko Konagai and three "cats" Maa, Roo, Shii. These cats are girls with cats' ears and can speak human language.

Note: Includes 1 bonus chapter.

99094.description: The series is about a man named Kusaka who has a fascination for marshmallows. Kusaka gets involved in a relationship with an office lady named Wakabayashi, and the story focuses on their relationship in the workplace.

title.native: おじさんとマシュマロ

99095.description: A 4-koma showing the daily lives and conversations of 20 ordinary (and not-so-ordinary) high school girls.

99096.description:
A "freeloading 4-koma" depicting the mundane and not-so-mundane everyday lives of Kumakura, a college student, and Angie, an angel who descended to Earth in her mission to help people.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

99098.description: High school girls everyday surreal life.

99099.description: High school girls everyday surreal life.

99101.description: Gag manga about the daily life of a three-piece all female punk 'band.'

title.english: Punk Teenage Girl Death Rock 'n' Roll Heaven
title.native: パンクティーンエイジガールデスロックンロールヘブン
title.romaji: Punk Teenage Girl Death Rock 'n' Roll Heaven

99102.description:
When she turns ten years old, Adele von Ascham is hit with a horrible headache–and memories of her previous life as an eighteen-year-old Japanese girl named Kurihara Misato. That life changed abruptly, however, when Misato died trying to aid a little girl and met god. During that meeting, she made an odd request and asked for average abilities in her next life. But few things–especially wishes–ever go quite as planned.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Said Make My Abilities Average!
ก็บอกว่าขอแค่ค่าเฉลี่ยไงล่ะคะ!

title.english: Didn't I Say to Make My Abilities Average in the Next Life?!
title.native: 私、能力は平均値でって言ったよね！

That life changed abruptly, however, when Misato died trying to aid a little girl and met god. During that meeting, she made an odd request and asked for average abilities in her next life. But few things–especially wishes–ever go quite as planned.

99104.description:
One day, the supervisor in charge of watching over Earth was taking care of a distortion, when they made a mistake that caused Kaoru Nagase to lose her physical body. Not only that, but reincarnating her into a different, less culturally advanced world is the only thing they can offer to do for her. Not one to take this turn of events sitting down, Kaoru makes a demand: the power to create potions at any time she pleases, with whatever effect she wants it to have—and it doesn’t stop there either. She asks for a magical Item Box, the ability to understand and speak every language, and the same body she had back when she was a fifteen-year-old girl. Using her newfound powers, Kaoru has to try and make a stable life for herself in a whole new world!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: ポーション頼みで生き延びます！

99105.description:
While trying to save a child who was going to be run over by a truck, Manai Zero loses his life. When he wakes up even though he should have lost his life, Manai is given the choice of being reincarnated, but in a different world, with a power called "Beloved by Spirits".

A world of magic and sprites, monsters and adventures!
synonyms: Yankee is loved by a spirits in a different world

title.native: ヤンキーは異世界で精霊に愛されます。
title.romaji: Yankee wa Isekai de Seirei ni Aisaremasu.

synonyms: Ikemen no Sempai ga Jitsu wa Dotei de Junjo deshita
The Hot Upperclassman Was Actually a Pure Virgin
รักฝึกหัดของเจ้าชายเวอร์จิ้น

title.native: イケメンの先輩が実は童貞で純情でした
title.romaji: Ikemen no Senpai ga Jitsu wa Doutei de Junjou deshita

99107.description: In a quiet village, Yeong Seol, an aristocrat, wakes from deep slumber, only to find a young man named Sun Jo-Yi trying to kidnap her.
synonyms: Neither A Long or Short Walk

99108.description:
Graduate student Song-Ah thinks her girlfriend Yoo-Sung is the cutest girl in the world. It doesn't matter if she's actually more sophisticated than adorable; Yoo-Sung is number one in her heart! So how is she supposed to react when some hot childhood friend suddenly enters the mix?!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

99109.description:
1-3. Kataomoi x Kataomoi (片思い×片思い); Gush 2014-12, 2015-12, 2016-08
Out of nowhere, Hanamoto was suddenly called out by Furuya from different class. At first, he thought that he was gonna confess to him because he appeared to be nervous, but he was only asking to be his friend. What was Furuya's intention for befriending him despite not knowing each other??

4. Kimama ni Kuchizukete Douzo (気侭にくちづけてどうぞ); 2015-03
5. Motto Zuruku Kawaigatte yo (もっとずるく可愛がってよ); 2015-09

title.native: 駆け引きのインサイド・ベット

99113.description:
The story centers on a 19-year-old female video shop clerk named Chiaki Sakata and Inari, a elementary school boy who keeps sneaking into the adult section.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Chuuko Video-ya no Onna Ten'in X
Used Video Shop's Female Shop Clerk X

title.native: 中古ビデオ屋の女店員 X
title.romaji: Chuuko Video-ya no Onna Tenin X

99114.description: "Tears" connect people who have never met before. This is the story of an honour student and a delinquent who are connected through these tears.
synonyms: I want to make you cry

99115.description:
In her Junior High years, the pitcher Yomi Takeda was not able to get very far in a cross-school baseball tournament. Since the catcher on her team wasn't at her level, she couldn't use her signature move, the "Magic Throw," and eventually regretted not being able to use it. After Junior High, she decided to stop playing baseball and went to Shin Koshigaya High School, a school without a baseball club. There, she found her long lost childhood friend, Tamaki Yamazaki, who used to play catch ball​ with her when they were kids. Tamaki also played baseball during her Junior High years as a catcher, and could even catch Yomi's "Magic Throw!"

Their promise with each other during their childhood could now be fulfilled! Walking together on the road of baseball once again...

The story of the girls who love baseball will begin!

99117.description:
A collection of stories that will “reward” you with the joy of falling in love with every fiber of your being, and the happiness of being loved completely.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

1. 12-jihan ni Ano Café de (12時半にあのカフェで)
2. Otome wa Kakumo Yokubukaki (乙女はかくも欲深き)
3. Kyou kara Kareshi ni Narimashita (今日から彼氏になりました)
4. Sono Netsu goto Hoshikunaru (その熱ごと欲しくなる)
5. Yakusoku no Kizuato (約束のきずあと)
synonyms: 工作完成後請給我獎賞

title.native: お仕事おわりにごほうびを

99118.description:
Chihaya-san wa Sonomama de Ii (Chihaya is Fine the way She is) follows the life of an average high school girl, Chihaya, who thinks she is overweight and wants to lose weight. Unfortunately, its impossible for her to keep her appetite in check, especially with his childhood friend, Shima constantly bombarding her with food. Can Chihaya resist her urge to eat and succeed in her diet?

Included chapters: 18.1, 18.2
synonyms: Chihaya-san wa Sono Mama de Ii
Chihaya is Fine the way She is

title.native: 千早さんはそのままでいい

99119.description:
Bard Cornelius: the son of a nobleman of Mauricia, an empire located in a parallel universe. But Bard is no ordinary boy―he's got three souls packed into one body! Aside from his own consciousness, he's got Oka Sanai, a miserly samurai, and Masaharu Oka, a high school otaku who loves animal ears. With his extra knowledge of military tactics and business acumen, Bard's ready to cheat his way to the top!

(Source: One Peace Books)

title.native: アラフォー社畜のゴーレムマスター
俺、冒険者！～無双スキルは平面魔法～
title.romaji: Ore, Boukensha! Musou Skill wa Heimen Mahou

title.native: そのガーゴイルは地上でも危険です
title.romaji: Sono Gargoyle wa Chijou demo Kiken Death

99124.description: Ruma is just a normal high school girl, living with her younger brother, and having fun at school when three handsome boys suddenly show up! Little does she know that they're not just handsome, they're actually from outer space. And what are the strange dreams she keeps having about a bright light?...

99125.description:
This is a 200-year romantic story filled with love and hate. After sleeping for 200 years, the Vampire woke up to find his rival hunter is living with him! Did his memories fail him? This is simply unbelievable!

(Source: Webnovel)

99126.description:
The word "Imaemangryang" refers to all the monsters of the world. "Seobang," the Imaemangryang who protected Jeongjo, sets out to prevent a disaster that has awakened after 300 years. To do so, he must protect "Han Yu-Jeong," a woman with mysterious powers...

A bloody battle begins between Imaemangryang, who have adapted to the modern world, including goblins, maegoo, Jangsanbeom, and Du-eoksini.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

99127.description:
In this heartwarming series, Hana stumbles upon a special coffee shop where the spirits of the dead still linger. Each soul has a story, everyone has a final wish. By helping them, Hana finds another side of herself and those around her.

Source: Tappy Toon

99128.description:
Ariadna Lereg Ilestri Pre Agrigent. And so my life begins with this ridiculously long name, born to royalty and the center of attention — all because of one dangerous man; the veritably insane tyrant king, ruthless conqueror of ten empires, nightmare of all continents… and my father?! Will I be able to survive this maniac? Based on the hit series of novels.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: คุณลูกสาวผู้น่ารักของจักรพรรดิบ้าเลือด

99129.description:
Devastated after the death of her only daughter, Eunjo joins a group suicide. Instead of death, she opens her eyes to the days before. Fate is cruel as she must now relive each joyful moment with the pain of knowing what's to come. As she flashes back into the past, Eunjo realizes her future is set in stone... or is it? Can she change this twist of time for the better somehow and save her loved ones?

(Source: Tappytoon)

99134.description: Boy meets foreign cosplayer. Everything else is just a mixture of funny settings and sexy situations between this odd couple.

99135.description: Ogamine Maru is a shinobi serving the emperor who hates being used by people. However, after getting involved in a conflict that ended up in the murder of the head of a family, he begins a journey together with the head’s child for the "mokuroku" to unite the Takatsuji family again.

99137.description:
The manga centers on a demon from the underworld who comes to the human world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

99138.description:
Werewolves, vampires, dragons, and all sorts of other mythological beings are real, and they live hidden among us. But in order to stay hidden, they need special doctors who can treat them without having to worry about their true natures being revealed. Toketsu Tatsumaki is one such doctor, a young yet brilliant human boy who has genetically altered his own body to better be of service to the supernatural community.

Winner of Weekly Shounen Jump's 2015 Golden Future Cup.

99139.description: These are the recollections of a group of men who bet everything on their bicycles. The central pillars of their respective teams, the 3rd years. New stories revealing their pasts is about to begin!!

99140.description:
Struggling with the idea of living alone and adjusting to the effects of her previous book’s success, this follow-up to the award-winning autobiographical comic continues the author’s quest for self-acceptance and love.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes three extra chapters and the one-shot “Chika-chan no Yuuutsu”.
synonyms: Diário da Minha Experiência Comigo Mesma
Lettere a Me Stessa - Dopo la Mia Prima Volta

99141.description:
In Orario, the only place in the world that hosts the entrance to the massive subterranean Dungeon, there's a certain tavern where the most desperate and vulnerable bring their troubles. There, the ex-adventurer Lyu Lion uses her terrifying strength to wrest what justice she can from the shadows of the Labyrinth City! But when a girl goes missing and all evidence points toward the powerful Grand Casino, she may need more than brute force to help...!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.
synonyms: 파밀리아 크로니클 episode 류 (던전에서 만남을 추구하면 안되는 걸까 외전)

title.english: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Familia Chronicle Episode Lyu
title.native: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうか ファミリアクロニクル episodeリュー
title.romaji: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Familia Chronicle Episode Ryuu

99142.description:
For the skilled former adventurer Ryu, it's another eventful day at the Benevolent Mistress! A certain couple's only daughter has been kidnapped, bringing Ryu out into the streets to search for her, in the name of justice and Astrea. Her investigation of the missing child eventually leads her to a lawless area of the Labyrinth City, the Grand Casino, where money and power decide everything!

This is the start of the Gale Wind's tale in the city of Orario, home of the Dungeon and adventure!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Ryu Gaiden: Grand Casino wo Buttsubuse!
มันผิดรึไงถ้าใจอยากจะพบรักในดันเจี้ยน Familia Chronicle Episode Ryu
