title.romaji: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka: Familia Chronicle - episode Ryuu

99143.description: Follows the daily life of a professor and a robot girl in a post-apocalyptic setting.
99143.hashtag: #ぼっち博士とロボット少女の絶望的ユートピア

title.native: ぼっち博士とロボット少女の絶望的ユートピア
title.romaji: Bocchi Hakase to Robot Shoujo no Zetsubou Teki Utopia

99145.description: Mitsu Hanasaki is at first sight a harmless and petite girl, who has a weakness for sweet things. But when things get serious, she knows how to defend herself! But when her classmate Kumagaya, who is described as "Cruel Grizzly" at school, is approaching her in the train, she is terrified! However, Kumagaya is a gentle boy who loves handcraft, secretly working under a secret identity and making cute things. Can Mitsu still resist ...?

99146.description:
Where artistry meets fantasy.

When his musician sister suddenly goes missing, wood sculptor Baek Beom is thrown into the world of Artificers, immortal beings that obtain magical abilities through mastery of their craft. Determined to get answers, he teams up with Gino, an Artificer searching for a way to turn back into a human.

(Source: Manta)

99149.description:
Behold, a great detective who thrills the world solving impossible cases in no time! His name? Keiichiro Nagumo. …But all of that was over a decade ago. Now he's just your typical middle-aged dude. Nagumo is behind the times to the point that he doesn't even know what a smartphone is. But out of the blue, he is confronted by a high school girl named Mashiro who shows up wanting to be his assistant. Witness the miracles a gender-gap detective duo can make!

(Source: One Peace Books)
99149.hashtag: #まったく最近の探偵ときたら

title.native: まったく最近の探偵ときたら
title.romaji: Mattaku Saikin no Tantei to Kitara

99150.description:
The everyday life of a poor student, Kamenashi, as documented by his classmate who has a crush on him!

Included chapters: 6.5, 10.5, 13.5, 19.5, 26.5, 26.9

title.native: 貧民超人カネナシくん

99151.description:
1. Iinari Housekeeper
Yuuya, a NEET, has been entrusted by his older sister and parents to look after his nieces, the twins Misaki and Sasa, since their mother, his sister, is too busy with work. He is to be their live-in housekeeper, but when he starts doing their laundry and finds adult panties, he puts them on his face, apparently to "better understand the twins". In any case, he forgets he has them on until he greets the twins when they return home...

2. Umi demo! Iinari Housekeeper
Yuuya takes the twins to a beach, but other than playing in water, Sasa has different activites planned.

3. Okyakusama ni mo! Iinari Housekeeper
The twins invited their friends over. Yuuya is about to start making dinner for them all but is instead pulled to play the king game.

4. Secret in the Dark
Takamiya has come to meet his girlfriend's, Manami's, parents in her home. He is nervous, but he gets along with Manami's little sister, Honoka, very well from the moment they meet. However, Honoka plans to get along with him even better, and is not at all shy to make bold advances.

5. Hentai Temptation
An elementary school teacher is being seduced by Kirishima, one of his students and a junior gravure idol. This has been going on ever since he has expressed his support for her job, but Kirishima is about at the limit of her patience.
synonyms: They're Just Kids But They're Sluts

title.native: 子供だってエッチなの

99154.description: Kiyomi is a college student whose communication skill is infinitely close to zero. With her ability to figure out the recipe for a meal she had, Kiyomi starts working part-time at "Aun".

99155.description: Comical essay of Yuki Shirono living in Germany.

title.native: とつげきドイツぐらし!

99156.description: A short story about the blossoming love between two sisters.

99157.description:
Frosch, Juvia, Gray, Erza, Natsu, Lucy, and a mystery character!?!? The Fairy Tail Matsuri (festival) is here!! 4 special one-shots from Fairy Tail creator Hiro Mashima serialized in Kodansha's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine, Magazine Special, Young Magazine and Monthly Shonen Magazine.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

99158.description:
The fathers of the Go and Do families promised each other when they were young that they would raise their families side by side and they did just so. Years later, their kids are now teenagers/young adult who have been with each other most of their lives and are childhood friends. This is the story of the kids, their friends, and the relationships that weave them together yet just might be changing too.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

99159.description: Juri Yukawa lives with her NEET father and brother, her retired grandfather, her sister (a single mother) and her young nephew. One day, her nephew and brother are kidnapped for ransom. Having only 30 minutes to meet the demands of the kidnappers, Juri, who realizes there is not enough time to prepare the money, decides to head for their rescue by herself with knife in hand when her grandfather uses a mysterious stone passed on in the Yukawa family to stop time. In a world where everyone and everything are inert, Juri and her father and grandfather run to rescue the two. But at the kidnappers' hideout, they soon realize they are not the only ones who can move about in this still world...

99160.description:
Mayuzumi Asahi is a university student in Economics who lives alone and from time to time cooks for his two buddies.
He also is a Otaku for a magical girls show called "Ikai no Majoko" (t/n: "Magical Girl from another World") and collects figurines, posters and other merchandise of it. This show has a twist that reveals that the Attackers from another world are actually from 10000 years in the past, which makes him consider the show a masterpiece.
One day a girl with a black cat on her shoulder breaks into his apartment and attacks him with a stun gun while he is doing the dishes. He accidentally cuts himself on a knife in the process.
After that ordeal he goes to work at his in a shop for Anime-related goods. In the process of going after a female costumer who'd forgotten something he saves her from harassment, but gets beaten up by the harasser for his troubles. Luckily he suddenly summons a flaming car that runs the Attacker over? He understandably gets taken into police custody afterwards, who decide to drug and kidnap him to a remote location. After getting questioned by masked figures in black uniforms they decide that he is a Witch and burn him alive accordingly.

99161.description:
A story of a lonely werewolf seeking love in a world full of lies.

(Source: Toomics)

99162.description:
Mashiro is beautiful, flamboyant and... loose. So what happens when, spurned by his sometimes-lover, he meets a serious-looking guy who wants to treat him well...?

Includes side story: No Color Lover (ノーカラーラバー)

99163.description:
In a spa town, there is a high school girl called Misato Kagachi, who has snakes grown on her head (?) and eyes that turn any onlookers to stone—symptoms of a condition called Medusa Syndrome. One day, she was confessed to by a transfer student, Fudo, only to find out what captured his heart is her head or, more specifically, the snakes…!! Here begins a warm and cosy youth romcom.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Included one-shot: Volume 2, Mitsume Mitsukura no Saiyuuki

title.english: A Medusa in a Spa Town

99166.description:
The story will feature the Justice League heading to Gotham City to protect the world from the Joker and an alliance of super-villains.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: バットマン アンド ジャスティスリーグ

99167.description: Accidentally stumbling across a hidden attic after moving back to a house in his hometown, Yeoh-Ho finds a 10-year-old diary which makes him recall the memory he most wanted to erase: the day his friend Jae-Ha died!

99168.description:
Hino Miharu will be spending this Christmas just like the last: alone and working a dead-end job. All he wants is good employment, but when he meets a Santa Claus dressed in clothes as black as coal, he has no idea he’s encountered the real deal…sort of. The Santa Claus dressed in red makes Christmas happen for good children everywhere, but his darker counterpart handles the holiday for the bad kids. As a name on the naughty list, Miharu is dashed away to work for the shadowy Santa. The pay and benefits are great, and his co-worker is cute–but will this end up being the dream job he’s wished for, or a nightmare of a Christmas?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: ブラックナイトパレード

99169.description:
Sachi Numakoshi is a single woman who goes around looking at model rooms, constantly dreaming and searching for her dream apartment.

(Source: Anime News Network)

99170.description:
For average girls, high school is a time of insecurity, of finding yourself and railing against your imperfections. In one particular high school, five average, unpopular girls take life one day at a time, learning as they go, and stumbling as they try to find their footing.

(Source: Lovely Strange Dark)
synonyms: Zassou tachi yo Taishi o Idake

title.native: 雑草たちよ 大志を抱け

99171.description:
Story revolves around seamstress Ichie, a young woman who has inherited her grandmother's Western dressmaking shop.

In the first volume, Ichie is sewing a wedding dress for a close friend. While sewing, Ichie remembers her grandmother Yukino, who first opened the shop in order to make her daughter Hiroe's wedding dress. Now her grandmother's dresses will be on display in a department store and Ichie wonders if wearing these clothes are really a blessing...

(Source: Anime News Network)

99172.description:
A look into the lives of the various residents in one quiet community.

Note: Winner of the 2014 Japan Media Arts Festival New Face Award.

99174.description:
Oichan is frustrated with everyone and everything going on in her school. There is one man who makes her feel special and forget all about her problems, but he barely knows she exists!

Will she be able to attract his attention and win his affection, or will she be doomed to forever watch him from afar?

99175.description: Saionji Koharo is an admirable student council president. A beautiful and flouncy lady that happens to always be followed around by a girl named Mirai.

title.native: 私の友達が世界一かわいい。
title.romaji: Watashi no Tomodachi ga Sekai-ichi Kawaii.

99176.description: Tsukimiya is a dutiful kid who has been looking after his family since his mother's passing, and a popular pretty boy at school, but he rejects all those who confess to him due to an unrequited love he holds for one of his teachers. However he suddenly finds himself kidnapped by a group of beautiful women, who promise him a life of daily torture from now on.

99177.description: The manga centers on first-year high school student Minoru Suzuki, who sometimes sees visions of his own mother's past as a high school student.

title.native: 大蜘蛛ちゃんフラッシュ・バック

99178.description:
Ten years ago an attack by giant monsters called Idola floating in the sky leveled Washington D.C. and awakened humanity to the existence of other live forms. It took years to develop a measure to counter them, via humanoid Idola-derived robots that are controlled by pilots via brain waves.

Ilya Kravitz is a young wheelchair-bound kid and prospective pilot taking the pilot examination who lives alone with his sister Anna Kravitz in New York City. Will he manage to fulfill his dream of becoming a Pilot? How will he fare against the Idola?

99179.description: Everyday a boy goes to a cafe to watch the girl he likes from afar. Using the reflection in the window, he orders the same things she orders and eats it the same way she eats it. Hoping to learn as much about her as he can, he works up the courage to confess.

title.native: 鏡ごしのミルクケーキ
日焼け少女は最高だぜ！

99181.description: A poison-attribute heroine makes her appearance! This chaotic, high-school comedy focuses on the circumstances of this poisoned, poisonous girl and the unusual people surrounding her!

99182.description:
Travelling salespeople visit a small, remote town. However, neither the town, it's inhabitants, nor the salespeople are what anybody would consider "normal."

A supernatural crackpot comedy.

(Source: Batoto)

99183.description:
Yukishiro Nanako is a cute, cheerful high school girl with one peculiar trait – instead of verbal communication, she writes senryu (a type of haiku) poems to relay her thoughts. Together with ex-delinquent Busujima Eiji, they are budding freshmen of the school’s Literature Club.

Even though Nanako doesn’t talk, with the power of senryu, the adorable pair has no problem enjoying their fun school-life through the tune of 5-7-5 syllables.

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

title.native: 悪魔伯爵の花嫁 白き乙女と赤い果実
title.romaji: Akuma Hakushaku no Hanayome: Shiroki Otome to Akai Kajitsu

title.native: 一途な深愛 薔薇の庭で抱きしめて
title.romaji: Ichizu na Shinai: Bara no Niwa de Dakishimete

99188.description:
1. Kakozato Suzushiro (加古里・スズシロ)
2. Kaze no Fuku Fuku (風の吹く吹く)
3. Ashita no Kyouko (あしたの今日子)
4. THE WORLD
5. Koisuru Taiyoukei Dai-3 Wakusei Chikyuu Zaijuu 13-sai (恋する太陽系第3惑星地球在住13歳)
6. Niwa e Yuku (庭へゆく)
synonyms: Koisuru Taiyoukei Dai-3 Wakusei Chikyuu Zaijuu 13-sai

title.native: 誰がそれを－田中相短篇集－

99189.description:
Kirito and Sinon's battle with Death Gun is over, but mere weeks later, something strange is afoot in the next-generation VRMMO ALfheim Online. A new duelist with a custom sword skill is defeating all comers--including Kirito! But when Asuna goes to face this duelist, she receives something she never expected: an invitation to an exclusive guild! But what is their aim? The Mother's Rosario arc begins!

Note: Covers the Mother's Rosario Arc from Volume 7 of the light novel series.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: ソードアート・オンライン マザーズ・ロザリオ

99190.description:
Always dreaming of a handsome prince on a white horse, Gong Ji-U has been waiting for the day to confess her feelings to her prince Han Tae-Jun. However, the least expected person has got her fired up with jealousy. What will it take to make you mine?

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue for season three.

99191.description:
Shiwoo always used to say, “Yujin, you’re my favorite person in the whole wide world.” And Shiwoo always believed he was truly special to Yujin. After all, Shiwoo never really liked all those girls he dated, anyway. But when Yujin finally confesses his love, he finds himself rejected and alone... Years later, Shiwoo is a celebrity. The hard-to-manage celebrity gets a new manager that seems so familiar... her name is even Yujin... It takes but one night of too many drinks for Shiwoo to discover she isn’t really what she seems.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Include ten extra chapters.

99192.description: Jason used to be a popular actor of the TV drama "The Mark of Watzel". However, he is just a fraudulent salesman now. Suddenly Jason receives a request: "I want you to deceive my daughter who is sick and has just a few months to live". Will Jason ever be the hero Erin admires so much?

99193.description:
Muroi Yuuya is tired of being compared to his brother Takumi who is looked up to by everyone. To vent his frustration, Yuuya starts frequenting the 'Hole Wall Specialty Shop'. Only being able to see the back of the person he is having sexual intercourse with, Yuuya soon develops a superiority complex and gets hooked on an employee with the stage name 'Taku'. However, one day he notices a mole on his brother's right hand which is the same as the one Taku has?

Included one-shot: Oshiete Shotacon Sense!

99194.description: Kuromine is a succubus who has been suppressing his hunger for a long time. What happens when Touno Kei tries to tempt him?

99195.description: A collection of oneshots about young men who love to party and have a good time.

99198.description:
Mimasaka-san is hiding a big secret that will lead to his perdition... when Kagaya finds out and makes use of it to catch him.

Note: Published in Pink Gold vol. 5

99199.description: Masashi Satou's childhood friend, Riku, often gets the attention of those wanting to have sex with him. Masashi knows Riku is gay for him, and a past session of pleasuring his friend does not help him. Masashi becomes angered by watching others advance on Riku. What will he do to change how things are?

99201.description:
After pretending to be hopeless in math to spend time with the boy of his dreams, Luke manages to conquer Eric's heart and begin a relationship. But it seems like Eric doesn't show any kind of emotion.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Satou Masashi no Heya" (佐藤まさしの部屋)

99202.description:
Cole, a gay college student, has a crush on the boy next door, Alex Rodriguez. Cole can only watch Alex from a distance, all the girls flocking to the one he wants while being forced to satisfy his urges alone. Then one day, that distance starts to disappear when a drunken Alex falls asleep in Cole's bed. Emboldened, Cole goes to a costume party in hopes of talking to Alex and ends up confessing his true feelings. Alex is used to this kind of thing, casually brushing it off, but Cole doesn't know what to do and comes up with...!

A dark-haired hunk and an average blonde gay guy; two polar opposites meet in this homosexual-romance slice-of-life drama!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: スイートハート・トリガー

99203.description:
Whenever Tomo gets a girlfriend, his selfish childhood friend Hideaki comes between them. Now that Tomo has a new girlfriend, he's on the lookout, but nothing happens. Thinking the lack of intervention strange, Tomo then discovers that Hideaki has a new lover—a man! Maybe he was just showing off, but Tomo can't forget how gentle his friend looked when he was worrying about love.

A straight guy easily moved by kindness and affection and an egotistical hottie with a strong desire to monopolize. They can't go back to the time when they thought they knew everything—a romance blossoms between friends.

99204.description:
Yui's younger friend Mikki always seems to turn up at the same school as him. They've been together all through middle school, high school, and college. Mikki's got an attitude, but deep down, it seems he's in love with Yui... Yui's always felt superior to Mikki, but one day, he takes his provocation a little too far...!

(Source: Renta!)

99205.description:
Ikuta Aoi has a crush on a girl in his class and tries to confess to her, but in his nervousness accidentally insults her. To make matters worse, the whole embarrassing scene is witnessed by Shizu, the handsomest and most popular teacher in school...who also happens to be the object of Aoi's crush's affections.

One thing leads to another, Aoi ends up speaking rudely to Shizu, and from there on out finds himself being forced to run errands for him as penance...
synonyms: กว่าจะเอ่ยคำรัก

99206.description:
This collection of short stories by Wu Ya is a series of wonderfully suspenseful love stories with fantasy elements.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

99207.description:
The manga centers on a 16-year old high school student and amateur manga creator named Tatsuya Egawa, who perceives himself as unpopular and hated by the girls in his school. He tries to submit a manga manuscript to Shonen Sunday but is turned down. In despair, he turns to the Internet for advice, finding out that there is a manga creator with whom he shares the exact same name and birthday (the real-life Tatsuya Egawa).

From Egawa's manga, the 16-year old Egawa takes away that he must draw from experience, and that he must learn how to draw cute girls. Since he has no experience talking to cute girls, he resolves to get to know one at his school.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Horizon of Oblivion: A Letter to the 16-Year Old Me

title.native: 忘却の涯て 16歳の自分への手紙
title.romaji: Boukyaku no Hate: 16-sai no Jibun e no Tegami

99209.description:
"No living creature has returned alive from Gunma."

Despite the warning of his childhood friend who moved to Gunma, Nori Kamitsuki still transfers to the high school in Gunma.

title.native: お前はまだグンマを知らない
title.romaji: Omae wa Mada Gunma wo Shiranai

99218.description:
Hyeong-Oh’s disability has always painted a target on his back. It seems like no one at school, from his classmates to his teachers, can stand to treat him like a human being. That is until transfer student Cha Nam-Soo arrives. Quiet and straightforward, he makes no excuses for staying by Hyeong-Oh's side, but can Hyeong-Oh bring himself to trust this new friendship?

(Source: Tapas)

99219.description:
A romantic comedy about a boy and his social media rage; a story of social media and the crossing fates of a young man and a young woman who were never supposed to meet.

Say hello to Daichi, a.k.a. Mr. Harmless. Because of his compulsive need to be liked, he never makes waves and maintains an easy going attitude. So easy going, everyone thinks he's a dud. But online he's a stud! His angry otaku online persona has garnered him thousands of followers! But real life and online life are two very different things. A lesson he's going to learn the hard way!

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Haru yo, Koi!: Fuyu-hen, Haru-hen
Volume 3: Gachipin.
Volume 4: Gesu no Ongaeshi

99220.description:
University student Satake Aoi wakes up rolled up in a red string and with a stranger inside his house that says he's a god. Aoi scapes, but something is... different... He's now extremely popular and everybody's fighting for his attention. What's the relation between these events and some promise he made with the man that calls himself the god Ookuninushi-no-mikoto and what will happen from now on?

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.native: Baby Doll: 義父と義兄に奪われた夜
title.romaji: Baby Doll: Gifu to Gikei ni Ubawareta Yoru

99222.description:
"Who are these two good-looking guys on my sofa?" Rei finds herself confronted with this mystery after returning home from another long day at a law office. Entrusted in her care by her mother in the fashion biz, these two model proteges become Rei's new "pets" – at least, that what she tells herself. Still, how many pets out there cook dinner and do the laundry in addition to providing some much-needed TLC? Confronted with this unusual – and enviable – situation, Rei senses her life beginning to change...

(Source: Renta!)

99223.description:
1. Koi wa Ninkyou
2. Kaihatsu♥Ecstasy
3. Flavor of Love
4. Yajuu ni Kokoro Ubawarete
5. Mitsuai Appointment

99224.description:
Story 1 - When Nikaidou Hisashi became Mikiya?s next door neighbor, they hit it off right away. When they start to seeing each other more at the office, it gets harder for them to deny their feelings for each other.

Story 2 - Growing up with his best friend,Azusa admires Yuuichi-"niichan" even though he gets annoy by his behavior. Azusa wishes him to act more properly/mature.Is Yuuichi really what Azusa sees him as or did Azusa gets it all wrong? What will happen next?

title.native: フェロモン探偵シリーズ
年下彼氏に迫られてます。
プライベートレッスン　謀略は王子の嗜み
title.romaji: Private Lesson: Bouryaku wa Ouji no Tashinami

99229.description:
A collection of multiple flagrantly erotic short stories centered around the eternal romance of two lonely vampires.

1. Nemureru Mori no Vampire (眠れる森の吸血鬼, Sleeping forest Vampire)
Humans no longer venture near the distant ruined castle where vampires live in quiet solitude. One such creature, Alexander, is confronted by a fledgling named Mihal who declares, "I love you, and I want your body and your heart..." While deliberating, Alexander invites Mihal into his old bedroom... He allows the younger vampire to form a physical bond, but will Mihal be able to win his heart...!?

2. Alice Help Me! (アリス ヘルプミー！)
Kazushi is sorting his things before going to university. Suddenly, he finds his favorite book "Alice in Wonderland" and falls asleep while reading it. He dreamt about the scenario from the book and meet the Rabbit, who proposes him something kids shouldn't read about.

3. Sasakawa-kun no Lucky Item (佐々川くんのラッキーアイテム)
Sasakawa Yukinari, despite his name, keeps getting into dangerous accidents. Upon finding Fortune Club Card, he decides to take his future in his hands and follow the fortune teller's advice. But why do his lucky items must always be so embarrassing?

4. Fall From Grace: Kimi ga Ochiru Sekai (フォール フロム グレイス ～君が堕ちる世界～)
A member of popular idol group "Sirius" created a scandal. As punishment, he had to change schools and got Mishina-sensei as a watch dog. He still acts frivolously till sensei starts to pursue his own agenda. Can Akira win with sensei?

5. Kabukichou no Hanayome (歌舞伎町の花嫁)
A host named Touya got suddenly confessed to on the street with the words "Please, be my wife" by another man.

6. Sentimental High Heel (センチメンタルハイヒール)
Yuzuki can't handle the noise his neighbor is making. He goes upstairs to confront him and finds that... his male neighbor is wearing high heels!?

7. Kocchi Muite, Makihara-kun (こっちむいて、牧原くん)
A sweet looking boy keeps pursuing a Yankee Makihara after a love session in the zoo.

(Source: Renta!, MangaUpdates)

title.native: ミッドナイト・メイク・ラブ

99232.description: Yuzuru, a yankee with a mean face, requests Satomi, his senpai, to "make him his little brother" in order to repay him for helping his family when they had money issues. Yuzuru then starts to follow Satomi around and serve him by tending to his every need. But Satomi is getting annoyed by all the attention, and our Yuzuru won't give up! Until Satomi decides to ask him to sleep with him...

99233.description: The you who sparkles on the water’s surface… You were supposed to be my senpai, and yet my heart starts to go strangely wild?!

99234.description:
“This belongs to me now, so don’t go touching it.”

The plain and unattractive Fushimi has always been concerned about Totori, the arrogant honour student with many enemies. However, he despairs at the fact Totori can’t even remember his name. As he was planning his revenge, he’s beaten to the punch by Asahina, the infamous school bully…?! The outsider who came late can only watch on– and an unusual love triangle unveils. Also included is “Ijimete Usagi-kun”, a story about a sadistic rabbit and masochistic delinquent.

title.native: いくじなしのスペクテイター

99235.description: Miharu is a hardcore otaku. She has been dreaming of meeting her favorite manga character in real life. Then one day, Miharu witnesses the heroine from Elemental Symphony of Vogalchevalier fighting Military Uniform Princess. It was the day her everyday life started to change.

99236.description:
The school's fastest track star, Namsu. An old friend from the past, Hye-Yeon. Everyone's adorable sweetheart, Joy. High-school romance at it's best! The comic that made Pito one of the best in the GL genre.

(Source: Lezhin)

99237.description:
What if you could choose and get your ideal lover online?And what would you do if it actually happens? A story about a woman who gets a boyfriend online to get her ex jealous but instead, finds herself falling for that man, no matter how hard she tries not to.

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: ロマンティックマーブリング

99238.description:
A thrilling yet flirtatious relationship between the perverted girl Lee-ni, who gets excited from the wicked stares of men, and Du-jun, who is insensitive to sexual stimulus due to his father, who is an AV director, has begun! While showing off her cleavage and exposing her underwear, Lee-ni’s pride is hurt when Du-jun isn’t aroused even after seeing her bare form. The end result becomes an approach through all sorts of perverted acts in an effort to encapsulate him… What will the seduction of a pervert end up tasting like?

Note: The series has been cancelled due to the manhwaga's sexual harassment towards a female colleague.

99240.description:
There is a certain French Restaurant, Etoile Filante. Here, we have an owner with an extremely high level of clumisiness; Ryuusei and an extremely beautiful French wine adviser, Momo, and they are a lovey dovey couple.

However, Momo has a secret? The truth is, Momo is a type of human who is called ?Beastkin? as he transform into a lion when he is excited!! Now, will he remain as a lion and XXX with Ryuusei?!!??

Their lovey dovey-ness is warm and fluffy? However, it is a wee bit of a heartrending love story.
synonyms: Momo: ♂ Lion to Koubi no Jikan

99241.description:
At his former classmate's wedding reception, Natsuki is reunited with Haruomi, the guy he turned down ten years ago. It's not that Natsuki didn't like him, or had issues with dating guys... He just thought his dirty mind would tarnish Haruomi's innocence, and ran away.So, when Haruomi turns up with a whole new look and behaving provocatively, Natsuki can't hide his bewilderment. He knows he has no right to be jealous, but he can't help being irritated when he finds out his friend Kariya and Haruomi have gotten close behind his back.

On top of that, the two take Natsuki to their "secret spot," where Haruomi shows a depraved side of him Natsuki never knew he had... They've pined after each other for ten years.
Will this awkward pair finally bring their tantalizing dance to a close?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: เงื่อนรักพันธนาการหัวใจ

title.native: ラベルド・タイトロープ・ノット

99242.description:
My classmate Shinobu-san love cute animals. She goes crazy for sweets and does a part-time job. She claims that she's an ordinary high school girl, but no. She's not. She's a freaking ninja. And it seems that it's only me who knows her true identity.

(Source: Translation of the introduction page from Gessan)

title.native: 忍者シノブさんの純情

99244.description: Student council president and secretary, accounting and general affairs Seishirou Watari and student council vice president Mizutani. Only two student councils. Busy or not. Suggest or try it. Two people, but fun every day.

99245.description: On one hand there's Takumi. He's scary looking,strong in fights and respected by his juniors but in fact he's sensitive to the point of crying at every opportunity. On the other hand there's Natsuki, the "protector" appointed to Takumi. He's always around to prevent him from getting into trouble. The two boys are childhood friends and ever since Takumi came to his aid, when they were kids, Natsuki has been in love with him. He has no intention of ever revealing his true feelings but due to a strange combination of circumstances, Natsuki ends up stealing Takumi's first kiss! When an innocent Takumi suddenly becomes aware of his feelings and publicly asks Natsuki to go out with him, his surprise has no bounds…!

title.native: 恋する鷹はツメを隠す
title.romaji: Koisuru Taka wa Tsume wo Kakusu

99246.description:
As a homeroom teacher, Yahaba was worried about Yumino, his beautiful student who couldn’t make friends. When he visited his dorm and tried to help with his problem, he felt that he could no longer stop.
“I can’t say it now, but I won’t let anyone have you.”

A love story between a popular teacher who was trying his best to conceal his feelings, and a determined, tsundere student.

(Source: Renta! JP)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.
synonyms: Koi o Shita Sora no Majika

title.romaji: Koi wo Shita Sora no Majika

99247.description:
My beloved senpai is scary, superb, and suspicious!

Typical maiden high schooler Mano Akari is in love with Takaeda-senpai, a horror maniac whose hobby is touring around ghost spots. Compelled by love and impulse, Mano stalkerishly follows him and ends up seeing something she shouldn't?

99248.description:
Monko is a lonely traveler roaming the rough and wild roads west of Tokyo, and has set on a journey to find her perfect man. But in a land populated by bloodthirsty bandits and handsome landlords, who are sometimes one and the same person, she must use much more than her heart to find her ideal. With sword in one hand and a six-shooter in the other, it is her manifest destiny to search for love in all the wrong places!

(Source: Denpa)

99249.description:
Sayama Ten, a college student, is one day accosted in class by a handsome boy, Hachimaki Waka. His request is a bolt from the blue: Hachimaki wants to have sex with him! But they have never spoken to each other before and even if Sayama is gay, he is not the type to sleep with the first person who comes along. Furthermore, Sayama is a “cat” and Hachimaki is nothing like the man of his dreams. Yet, the very next day, even though Sayama rejected Hachimaki, the latter comes with a peculiar strategy: inundating him with strange gifts such as… fish-flavoured snacks? Is Hachimaki really taking him for a cat!?

Note:
- Originally serialized until March 25, 2016. Additional serialization started on July 7, 2017.
- Includes 3 extras.
synonyms: How to keep me, and how to scold

99250.description:
The story takes place in Meiji Era where Omegas were mistreated and despised for having their heat period.

Maya an Omega, with an unusual color for a hair captivated an elite Alpha named Seiji.

99251.description:
A startling collaboration between Fumi Fumiko and cultural commentator Sayawaka.

Hana was blissfully enjoying the halcyon days of school life along with her friends, right up until the moment she received a mysterious letter emblazoned with the phrase "don't say a thing". Uncertain of its origins, Hana consults with her friends which sets off a disastrous chain of events - changing each of their lives for the worse.

title.native: qtμt キューティーミューティー

99252.description:
The World's Greatest Storyteller telling his story in the most terrifying situation. What is his story? What is his motive?

(Source: Lezhin)

99253.description:
Young people waiting for a big wave. The life, healing and love stories that surfing presented to them.

(Source: Daum, translated)
synonyms: The Girl Who Walks the Waves

99254.description: Zoccha is a white and orange cat that lives with a young couple. One day, he finds himself dumbfounded by a beautiful cat. Will Zoccha find love? Join us on Zoccha's daily adventures!!

99256.description: A brothel tale of two brothers. Sold young by their mother, older Lan was once a great beauty, but now bears the disfiguring scars of a life in misery. Only fit for servant work, he watches over the blossoming younger Hui Hui who must now serve his first customer. As Lan wonders whether death wouldn't be kinder for them both, a customer requests him for the first time in years -- and it's a handsome young man. Can this fragile love save Lan, or will it consume the last of his hope?

99257.description: Note: Volumes 1 to 3 are titled with "はじめての (Hajimete no)".

99258.description:
1. Furueru Mune no
A story about a trembling chest, My senior's aroused nipples!
2. Shinyuu no Seiheki ga Chotto Kawatteita Kudan
3. Shinyuu no Seiheki ga Chotto Dai'ppchi ni Nattekita Kudan
4. Shinyuu e no Omoi Update Shitara Iroiro Afureta Kudan
5. Chigire Tate no Naka
6. Ore to Kimi to Ano Hito to
7. Torokere Kyuujitsu

99259.description:
1-4. Oshiete, Ookami-san. (教えて、狼さん。)
Chitose is a cute guy with a devilish hobby - that of 'fishing' - flirting and seducing guys with whom he has no intention of going out. His next target is the shy 'herbivore' Narita. Chitose lures Narita into his trap, but perhaps the prey is not what he seems to be and the hunter will become the hunted...?
5. Ijiwaru na Kare (いじわるな彼)
6. Koibana (こい花)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

99260.description:
Humans have created many stories. Joy, sadness, anger, deep emotion. Stories shake our emotions, and fascinate us. However, these are only the thoughts of bystanders. But what if the characters in the story have "intentions"? To them, are we god-like existences for bringing their story into the world? Our world is changed. Mete out punishment upon the realm of the gods. In Re:CREATORS, everyone becomes a Creator.

(Source: Anime News Network)

99261.description:
"......Do you hate me that much?" Ryouto and Kousuke meet when they enter a male beauty pageant at their college. Ryouto's a total hottie with a personality to match, and he considers the classically handsome Kousuke, who always steals the girls he's after, an arch-enemy. Out of jealousy and spite, Ryouto openly avoids Kousuke... But they still end up on a snowboarding trip together. Ryouto's only there to up his popularity with the girls, but then Kousuke gets into an accident that suddenly brings them much closer together......

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: パウダースノーメランコリー

99262.description:
Kaitou and Azuma are salesmen at a company who don't seem to get along. Kaitou decides to take Azuma drinking to try and figure out why everyone is gaga over him when Kaitou knows he's not so bad himself.

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "NO Money I Love You"
- Includes the one-shot "Jack to Heart"

title.native: ロマンチッカーズ・ハイ

99264.description: West of Tokyo, in Okutama, a witch named Minase Maho lives there in peaceful quietness.  Maho, who is a descendant of the once feared witch, decides to leave Okutama to attend college. Heading to the human village Shinjuku on the "Holiday Rapid Okutama", this is a story of a witch going to meet a lot of firsts.

99265.description:
Jun Nanami is a young model. Except, his agency is forcing him to work as a manga assistant! He's less than thrilled about the arrangement until he realizes the artist is actually his idol, ex-model Yudai Kase!! A high-and-mighty author falls for a bratty young model in this steamy love story!.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two parts of "Doujin wo Aishite (同人を愛して, For the Love of Amateur Manga)," and two extra chapters.

title.english: The Demanding Author Falls for the Loser
title.native: 強引作家と負け犬の初恋
title.romaji: Gouin Sakka to Makeinu no Hatsukoi

99266.description:
A world where machines yearn to understand and become humans and where one human seeks to become as strong and indestructible as these machines. A jam-packed action SF that will blow your mind away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

99267.description:
Chaewoon is back in school after taking 2 years off. She doesn't want any trouble and wants to graduate without any incident but she can't seem to help but get entangled with not only the most popular guy in the department, Sado, but also the hot-blooded freshmen Mingyu! So much for wanting a quiet school year!

(Source: Lezhin)

99269.description:
In the story, Shiori is job hunting when she receives a sudden part-time job offer from a man in front of the station. She gets in a taxi but suddenly starts to feel very sleepy. When she wakes up, she is in an eerie locked room. It seems she is stuck in a horrific situation, but it turns out the man works for a team of haunted house designers.

(Source: Anime News Network)

99270.description: Twelve children go to an abandoned hospital planning to kill themselves. In the room where they meet, an unknown boy is already lying dead...

title.native: 十二人の死にたい子どもたち

99273.description:
Second semester of eighth grade. A transfer student arrived at Eiji and Naohiko's school. It was Izumi, Eiji's close friend from elementary school. As the three spent time together, a new relationship started to grow... And then, time passed, and Eiji and the others became high school students.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 恋を知らない僕たちは

99274.description:
When a boy appears out of nowhere in your room claiming he was a succubus, what do yo do? Shimizu, the Fallen Angel, knows the answer.

A story about an insecure succubus and a sadistic Fallen Angel.

title.native: エルフでビキニでマシンガン!
title.romaji: Elf de Bikini de Machine Gun!

99276.description:
Do-Yeong's life as he knows it starts to turn upside down with the kidnapping of his sister, Do-Hui. With his psychometric ability, he finds out that the people who kidnapped his sister aren't normal humans and that there are many others with special abilities like him...

(Source: Lezhin US)

99279.description: A gay guy who has a nasty track record of falling for straight men, and a naive cafe owner who's under a kind of "curse" which makes him bump into people inappropriately... How will their relationship play out?

title.native: わざとじゃなくてもごめんなさい

synonyms: Wazato ja Nakute mo Gomen Nasai

99282.description:
One day, an ordinary high-school girl named Minase Youmu is kidnapped up in the mountains. Her kidnappers claim that she has taken some kind of "medicine" and that there's no going back. Luckily, though, a former detective named Sanpouji Kotetsu happens to pass by where she is being held, and rescues her. Kotetsu hastily gets the underage girl to the police, where the investigator Naru Asuka and her 'psychic' partner Hayama Reiichi take on the girl's case. Asuka, Reiichi and Kotetsu have to figure out who took Youmu--and what was done to her--before it's too late (if it isn't already)!

Source: MangaHelpers
synonyms: Youmu Minase and Really Weird Cthulhu Mythos

title.native: 水瀬陽夢と本当はこわいクトゥルフ神話
title.romaji: Minase Youmu to Hontou wa Kowai Cthulhu Shinwa

99283.description:
During a meteor shower, a magical Faerie appears in a dark alley. Lemon, the Fae Knight has come to the human world to complete his final knighthood test. Alongside him is his human companion, Mira, who dreams of being a Black Mage. Will Lemon be able to complete his test in time? Find out in this whimsical romantic comedy!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Be Careful of the Shooting Star!

title.english: The Knight of the Falling Star

99284.description:
Jin-A is a girl who’s always alone and has a depressed expression. Eun-Woo feels uneasy about her behavior and is concerned that she’ll commit suicide so he constantly hovers around her.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

99285.description: A series of Doujin by Otaku Beam.

title.native: スピリチュアルランチ

99286.description: A series of Doujin by Otaku Beam.

99287.description:
Mimori Seo is a ghost. Rather, he was a ghost (or something like it) for a whole year while his body lay in a coma recovering from a near-fatal fall. At least, that’s according to the story Iku Kurihara, a local convenience store clerk who for some reason has been visiting Mimori’s dreams, tells when he suddenly confesses his love to Mimori. But is that love meant for Mimori, or a phantom of the past he doesn’t even remember?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

99288.description:
When you wish for a Yuri love with all your heart, your wish might be granted by the Yuri Fairy. Just don’t forget to stamp her card.

(Source: Yuricon)

title.native: かなえて！ゆりようせい

99289.description:
Mino-san moved into a room with a small shrine on one wall. Unbeknownst to her, there is a cat spirit (who calls herself a ‘god’) living in the shrine. Chaos and comedy and cat jokes and wackiness ensues.

(Source: Yuricon)

title.native: ろくじょ~ひとまの ねこがみさま

99290.description:
A mixed bag of school stories, adult life, animal-eared girls, fairy tales and school mysteries.

1. Himesama Ringo wo Meshiagare (姫さま林檎を召し上がれ)
2. Atashi to Anata to Kanojo no Sofa (あたしとあなたと彼女のソファ)
3. Gakuen Kinkyori Renai Kaidan (学園近距離恋愛怪談)
4. Sekai wa Yuri de Michiteiru (世界は百合で満ちている)
5. Kisa to Saki to Akaiito to (キサとサキとあかいいと)
6. Watashi no Hero-san (私のヒーローさん)
7. Ganpeki ni Yuri no Hana wa Saku ka (岸壁に百合の花は咲くか)

(Source: Yuricon)
synonyms: Atashi to Anata to Kanojo no Sofa
Kisa to Saki to Akaiito to
Ganpeki ni Yuri no Hana wa Saku ka

99291.description:
Manabi and Taiyo have a dream of bringing Yuri-themed entertainment to the masses. When CEO Kise-chan creates a theater for her favorite performer Taiyo, their dream may be realized!

(Source: Yuricon)

title.native: シーズンシアターシアトリカル

99292.description: He has been a recluse for the past 10 years in that big house overlooking a bicycle parking lot. One day, a girl approaches and confessed to him, disturbing the world he's been cooping himself up in. A oneshot of their story by the mangaka of Tetsugaku Letra and Watashitachi no Shiawase na Jikan.
synonyms: The Prisoner in the Miniature Garden

title.native: パパと親父のウチ呑み
title.romaji: Papa to Oyaji no Uchi Nomi

99295.description:
The main character Tennoji boasts an overwhelming muscle mass which he cultivated at the gym, imposing himself to a strict diet in order to sculpt his body. However once every few weeks he has a "Cheat Day," a day where he is allowed to eat whatever he want how much he wants. The story follows Tennoji on his cheat days.

(Source: gurashii.com)

99296.description:
A 46-year-old man who has been divorced by his wife, has a financial problem in his company and a remarkable thing just happened when he was caught in a fire in a building—he goes back in time to his 16-year-old self.

Memories that were sepia colors start to move colorfully.

99297.description: A 14-year-old is planning to confess to her upperclassmen who is graduating. The next morning, she wakes as a 29-year-old single woman, living with three sisters: a high schooler, a middle schooler and an elementary schooler.
synonyms: Tomorrow I will tell you "I love you"

99298.description:
The top female stars of the school are in constant competition. Each has a harem, excellent grades and is beloved by all. Will supremacy be decided by whose "Prince" is best? Kaoru may look the part, but she's a reluctant Prince.

(Source: ALC Publishing)

99299.description:
1. Yuri no Onee-san (ゆりのおねえさん); Comic Yuri Hime 2015-03
A young boy named Shintarou gets to know the couple next door, Yurino and Miyako, and learns how love is all the same.

2. Tsumasaki ni Zero Kyori (つま先にゼロ距離); 2015-01

3. Kyuuchou-chan no Himitsu (級長ちゃんのひみつ); 2014-11

4-5. Naturize; 2014-05, 07

6. Naturize Side Story: Akazukin (ナチュリーズサイドストーリー 赤ずきん); 2014-09

99300.description: The story centers on a young scholar enrolled in an Anthropology seminary, who goes to Australia to observe rock paintings. While in a cave along with his colleagues the cave collapses...

99301.description:
Nico Nicolson observes and interacts with mangakas.

This interview session is devoted to famed Berserk mangaka, Miura Kentaro. His art process and his relationship to fellow friends and mangaka are addressed and insight is given into the style of art material he uses.
synonyms: Nico Nicholson no Manga Doujou Yaburi Ha

title.native: ニコ・ニコルソンのマンガ道場破り
title.romaji: Nico Nicholson no Manga Doujou Yaburi

99303.description:
A bittersweet tale about a girl who regains more than what she believed lost.

Everyday a lone girl sits on a certain bench in a park trying to remember what she has lost. A young man approaches her one day and offers to help her find what she is missing.

99305.description:
1. Shinsou no Koukishin
2-3. Paradise Found
4. Yumisaka-san no Baai
5. Seta-san no Baai
6. Yuutousei ni Hitsuyou na Jugyou (A Class an Honor Student Needs)
7. Drop Idol
8. Mystery Trap
9. Yuugure Toshokan (Library of Dusk)
synonyms: A Class an Honor Student Needs

title.native: 青春スウィートトラック

99307.description:
Your kiss smelled of lemons.

When Ga-Min steals a kiss from his sleeping classmate, Kang-Go, he’s positive he’ll never get caught. But what he doesn’t know is that Kang-Go has a unique gift — he can smell emotions. Now, Kang-Go’s on the hunt for the identity of his secret admirer, whether Ga-Min likes it or not.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: The chapter count includes 7 side story chapters.
synonyms: หอมกลิ่นรักสัมผัสหัวใจ

99309.description: It's just another day for this working man troubled by love, until a young girl appears before him, who happens to be his reincarnated mother.
synonyms: Is it Alright If The Grade School Student Is My Mother?
小學生當媽媽也可以嗎?
หม่าม้าผมเป็นเด็กประถมเหรอเนี่ย?

title.native: 小学生がママでもいいですか？
title.romaji: Shougakusei ga Mama demo Ii desu ka?

99310.description:
Kasumi and Akari are friends. They will learn together the meaning of love.
Meanwhile Kasumi's sister is having a surprising conversation with her female co-worker Sasano Ayumu.

Included chapters: 11.5, 16.5

99312.description:
With Kang Dol's crush on Yang Yang growing larger and larger, he decides to confess his feelings. With his back turned against her, he makes a courageous confession. But when he opens his eyes and turns around, instead of Yang Yang, he finds Min Dosim standing in front of him. Oops?! But the more shocking twist is that Dosim, the school's most popular girl, mistakenly obliges and they decide to go out! What is Kang Dol supposed to do to fix this mess?

(Source: Lezhin)

99313.description:
A collection of one-shots.

1-2. Sefure Ijou, Koibito Miman! (セフレ以上、恋人未満！)
About Nanami, a college student addicted to sex. He is called out by one of his many sex friends, the arrogant Kazuma. When he goes to their rendezvous place he's shocked to discover a second Kazuma! It's actually Shoma, his twin brother...

3. Kimi ga Boku no Number One (キミが僕のナンバーワン)
4. Ano Hi no Kiss wo, Mou Ichido. (あの日のキスを、もう一度。)
5-6. 2-jigen Love Holic (二次元LOVEホリック )
synonyms: More than sex friends but less than lover
imi ga Boku no Number One
Ano Hi no Kiss wo, Mou Ichido.

99315.description: Hiro Ayato doesn’t have a single living relative. He ends up working in a Western confectionery shop after being discovered by its owner, Narazaki Chitose. Ayato falls in love with Chitose, but the other man doesn’t appear to return his feelings. Having to live together with Chitose forces Ayato to lose his patience and he makes a move on him one evening. Their relationship becomes more intense, though Ayato is concerned about Chitose’s true intentions…

title.native: 繋がれ咬まれて恋をする

99316.description:
Due to his prosopagnosia, Michitaka Fukatsu (Sang) struggles with maintaining a normal school life. It’s hard to make friends when everyone’s face looks like an egg… literally. There’s only one person he can recognize -- Tomose Endou (Ujeong), a mysterious girl who seems to struggle with fitting in herself. In their pursuit to be “ordinary”, these two high-schoolers forge an unexpected friendship.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Includes an extra.

99317.description: Upon reaching fifteen years of age, the princess of the Kingdom of Akura, by custom, must undertake a baptismal journey. Nanami, a mage, is assigned to accompany the current princess, Princess Miki. Problem is, Miki is a trashy bitch that selfishly and arbitrarily demands that they kneel, which is a big pain. They’d blast her with their magic, but she’s royalty, and furthermore, the inheritor of the sacred power which is of vital importance to the world – so Princess Miki is doubly untouchable. Can Nanami safely finish this stressful journey and finally be released from the princess’ company?!

title.native: 姫じゃなければ殴ってる

99318.description:
“I am your future amore-your lover!” With these words, Pure Sakurasaka crashes into Akira Kouno’s life. As if it wasn’t wild enough that she says she’s come from six years in the future, Pure insists that in her time, she and Akira are engaged to be married! It’s an impossible claim, especially since Akira has sworn off 3D romance, content to immerse herself in 2D dating games. Besides which, why would someone as cute as Pure be interested in a loner like her…?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: ストロベリー・フィールズをもう一度

99320.description:
What do you do when presented with another version of you?

(Source: Tapas)

99321.description: Zuo Hui is an introverted high school student from a poor family. One day, when secretly working a part time job outside, he is caught by his mother. After the two have a heated dispute, Zuo Hui angrily turns away and leaves. Distracted by thoughts of guilt and regret, he loses footing and falls down a rain-flooded sewer hole. When Zuo Hui awakes he finds himself in a sealed room surrounded by a group of diverse strangers and with a rope around his neck. The more he struggles to take off the rope, the tighter it becomes. Where is this? Who are you people? And who exactly is that self-proclaimed “Yama”?

99322.description: Sister Nina appeared before the Demon Lord Edgar and request that he eat her as a sacrifice. With anger he simply replied with, "I don't eat humans".

99323.description:
When the mantis-like aliens known as Kiseichuu descend on Earth, they have one goal: eradicate the human race. They do so by absorbing humans’ H-energy–the sexual passion that fuels so many people and keeps the species reproducing! The government has assembled an elite team of superheroes to fight the bugs, aided by technology that allows them to transfer their erotic energy into super powers.

High schooler Retto Enjou is recruited onto the team, partnering with four beautiful girls, one of whom is his childhood friend Kirara Hoshino. Though they were once close, they’ve grown apart in recent years, since Kirara turned distant and aloof after an encounter with the Kiseichuu in her youth. Can Retto save the world, keep his team together, and maybe even melt his childhood friend’s newly cold exterior?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

99324.description: Iruma Suzuki has always been eager to please, even at the cost of his well-being. Worst yet, he's the son of two selfish parents who end up selling him to a demon. Thanks to their totally irresponsible actions, Iruma has found himself living in the Netherworld, where he must live and attend school as the grandson of an older demon. Luckily, his new, doting grandfather is there to help, but Iruma will have to figure out how to blend in with his demonic classmates or risk getting eaten. All he needs to do is subjugate rival classmates, summon familiars, and do other typical demon things while never revealing that he's human… Piece of cake, right?
synonyms: อิรุมะคุง พจญในแดนปีศาจ!

title.native: 魔入りました！入間くん

99325.description: After 12 long years, a white-haired boy by the name of Iori comes back to Mashira village, the place where his childhood trauma began, only to find yet another horror awaiting him.

99326.description:
Ever wondered about the daily lives of good-looking kids whose parents are Otaku?

Yang Wei, a kind and tall boy, is oblivious to the Otaku culture. On the other hand, Tong Qi, the girl who sits next to him at school, grew up knowing it all due to her parents' influence. With Yang Wei's and Ton Qi's parent(s) being geeks, the two see each other in common and discover what's latent to them.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

99327.description: I accidentally summoned my ancestor! How do I return him safely...!?

99329.description:
Qiu Yi is a salaryman in his 20s. After going to the wedding of his highschool crush, he becomes disillusioned as he thinks about the past. However, a sudden shocking event sends him back in time 10 years! ... as a girl named Ye Wen!? Qiu Yi faces another strange twist—his former self still exists!

【Am I still myself? Who exactly am I?】 What kind of sparks might ignite when he, as a girl, meets his male self?

99330.description: After her parents divorced, Cong Cong has been living alone, one day she goes to meet her idol, falls down a flight of stairs and travels through time.

99331.description:
Here comes a yuri anthology containing settings, illustrations, manga, etc. between junior high school girl x married woman! A married woman who is played by her daughter's friend, and an high-class mother who is attracted to a delinquent girl who is friends with her son! Please enjoy to your heart's content the slightly dangerous scent of beautiful girls and women intertwining with each other.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

1. Netsubyou (熱病)
2. Douyara Osananajimi ga Boku no Okaa-san wo Neratte Irurashii (どうやら幼馴染が僕のお母さんを狙っているらしい)
3. Silence (サイレンス)

Note: A preview was released at COMITIA 120. Chapters 1 to 3 were released at Comiket 93, COMITIA 124, and Comiket 95, respectively.
synonyms: Junior Highschool Girl x Married Woman
どうやら幼馴染が僕のお母さんを狙っているらしい
Douyara Osananajimi ga Boku no Okaa-san wo Neratte Irurashii

99332.description: “This is a game of the world. Complete the task and get whatever you want. ” So-called genius, Xia Tian, is invited to a college where students challenge each other to fulfill their own desires. He encounters many different people from beautiful ladies to underworld mafia bosses. Will he rise to the top and learn the truth behind this game?

99333.description: Set in the Edo Period, during a rainstorm, a temple receives a strange "visitor": Kurebayashi Aki, a high school student magically transported from the 21th century. Due to her uniform, which seems different from the clothing of that time, the people of the temple believe her to be an angel that has descended to help them with their problems, though Aki is really just a normal girl. Still, she figures she might as well help whoever she can while trying to find out how to go back home.

title.native: 大江戸!!あん・プラグド

99334.description: Jack the Ripper; Ed Gein; Andrei Chikatilo; John Wayne Gacy; Jeffrey Dahmer - separate from these serial killers who shocked the world, there exist offenders known as "Innocent Devils", who murder without malice. A criminal psychologist and her beautiful assistant probe the depths their minds.

title.native: INNOCENT-DEVIL イノセントデビル

99335.description:
A tournament using DOLL (humanoid robot suit) to be the last standing person.

Includes chapter 0.

99336.description:
How many stages should one experience to be intimate with others? Saying hello, getting along well, making friends, dating and being in a relationship and more…l love him", she's been practising this sentence in her mind over and over again, waiting a "correct" time to confess her love with him, one of her best friends. Thinking it is fate to see him afar, she's just about to say "what a coincidence" when she only found herself being in an awkward distress…

(Source: MangaToon)

99337.description:
In the world of demons where humans are simply an old folklore...

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

99338.description:
The manga is set in Edo during the Edo era, and centers on Jinbee, a thief catcher and whispered boss of the Edo streets. Renowned as handsome and reliable, his only flaw is a tendency to talk to himself too much. However, he has a secret. Jinbee's house is also home to a two-tailed cat spirit nekomata, and this is the story of their life together.

Includes 7 bonus chapters.

99339.description: The story begins with a middle-aged mother committing suicide due to problems with her adult son. Following her miraculous revival and return as a 20-year-old, she comes to know that her son does not, in fact, hate her like she'd assumed he did. However, in exchange for her second chance at life she's forced into playing deadly mind games with others in the same situation as herself.

99340.description:
A doormat of a realtor who's not over his last breakup.
A blackmailing, foul-mouthed young female mangaka who's run away from home.
Put them under one roof and this is probably what you'd get.

Note: Includes chapters 13.5, 21.5, 26.5.
synonyms: เกมรักมาวัดใจ

title.native: ガイシューイッショク！

99341.description: After failing the first blind date in his life, Oh Do-Kyung calls the friend who arranged the date. He's in the bathroom. During their conversation, his friend says something which angers Do-Kyung, which leads him to accidentally shouting his secret. His secret is that he is gay. To his shock, he realizes that there are other people in the bathroom: friends from his college department and even a senior student that he is on good terms with. Worried about whether or not they heard his secret, Do-Kyung's life completely changes.

99342.description:
Have you ever felt as if you are a protagonist of a fictional story? Then Ori's life could be called a cruel drama: the death of her parents, uncaring guardians, bullying in school, nervousness around people... But as a matter of fact she is... an invented character in the truest sense of the word! And the author, who decides her future, is already writing a tragic finale! Only, ignorant Ori does not obey his will...

Source: MU

99343.description:
1. Kyuukon Aite wa Ojisan x2
2. Shunkashutou Roshutsubiyori
3. Enjo Days
4. Yudetate Konyoku Onsen Tamago
5-6. Drapeko!
7. Osouji no Jikan
8. Shoujo Janai Mon!
9. Shisen no Mezame
10. Twins 30 Days
11. Oniichan e no Okurimono

title.native: いちごショコラふれーばー

99346.description:
“I would die if it would allow me to touch you. That is my love.”

Airhead Yuri-chan and her boyfriend Aono-kun had a perfectly normal relationship until one day Aono-kun suddenly “passed away” … They will never be bound together, and they cannot even touch. This is their difficult and almost too sincere love story.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Nominated to the 25th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.
synonyms: I want to die because I want to touch Aono

title.english: I Want to Hold Aono-kun so Badly I Could Die
title.native: 青野くんに触りたいから死にたい

99350.description: In the world where only the aristocrats have the power to fight the monster – mana. A youth named Kufa is dispatched as a tutor to find Mareida’s talent, a nuisance girl born in a duke’s family. If she is not talented, assassinate her. – that, is the dark side of his task...
synonyms: แอสแซสซินส์ ไพรด์

99351.description: In the world where only the aristocrats have the power to fight the monster – mana. A youth named Kufa is dispatched as a tutor to find Mareida’s talent, a nuisance girl born in a duke’s family. If she is not talented, assassinate her. – that, is the dark side of his task...

99352.description: The story of best friends Haruno and Chikaki who discover their feelings for each other may not be the simple, enduring friendship they assumed it to be.
synonyms: A Secret Just Between You and Me

title.native: 誰にも言えないふたりごと

99353.description: If you plant your yard full of red spider lilies, you can deceive spirits into believing it to be one of the many roads to the afterlife, and perhaps, meet those deceased dear to you...

99354.description:
Kouta Takeda who just started working at XOX Corporation, meets his new boss, a beautiful woman with big breasts named Kyouko Takizawa.

Included chapters: 27.5, 47.5

99355.description:
Onna no Ana (literally, Girl's Hole) is a collection of short stories about boys and girls linked by strange connections at a certain school.

1. Onna no Ana, (Girl's Hole)
2. Onna no Atama, (Girl's Head)
3. Onna no Buta, (Girl's Pig)
4. Onna no Oni, (Girl's Beast)

(Source: Anime News Network)

99356.description:
The enchanting flower maidens of Moonlight Garden are coveted by all, as they are known to provide sexual pleasures beyond the imagination. But Dohwa, a young flower maiden who has not yet “bloomed,” concocts potions in the hopes of escaping her destined fate at the brothel. One night, she is caught stealing ingredients for her potions by Lady Hyewon, the new mistress of the Garden. But it turns out Dohwa isn’t the only one with an agenda. Lady Hyewon harbors a few terrible secrets of her own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 3 epilogue chapters.

99357.description:
Eunha is heartbroken when she finds out her high school sweetheart, Siyeon, used an elixir to make her fall in love. When the two reunite 10 years later at a business meeting, Siyeon asks for a second chance. But before they can talk things out and rebuild their trust, greater magical forces interfere.

(Source: Lezhin US)

99358.description:
The lively yet clumsy new maid June does nothing right except cause trouble and yet, instead of berating June, the young and gracious madam forgives her and shows favoritism among the maids. Both have admiration and affection for one another, but will it turn into something more?

(Source: Lezhin)

99360.description:
A realist lesbian accidentally comes out to a closeted lesbian, whose only lesbian experience was through 2-D artworks. Find out how their college lives start involving a daily dose of lily.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

99362.description: "I love to eat delicious food! Eating is my happiness!" The food-loving protagonist, Sora Fukumi, needs to control her eating habits in school. By doing so, she thought to making friends, but while having dinner with her classmate and neighbor, Manjuu (Murai Mikoto), she again notices the wonders to eating delicious food... This is a chronicle of Fukumi, a gourmand who will learn through Manjuu's dinner!

99364.description:
Hamanishi FC is your average elementary school soccer team—or is it? While the team's record isn't impressive, it seems to have a bunch of diamonds in the rough. Soushi is super fast, Roku is a great leader, and the newest addition and only girl, Akira, seems to be great at all aspects of the sport. After Akira demonstrates her skills on the field, the team seems to accept her, even the stubborn Soushi. But boys will be boys...

(Source: VIZ Media)

Also contains:
Volume 3: extra chapter Aru Natsu no Ichinichi
Volume 4: Koganeiro chapters 1-3

99365.description: The story follows lawman Elmore Evans, who despite being one of the most amazing gunslingers in the West can't get rid of his bad luck in his romantic life.
synonyms: Lies of the Sheriff Evans: Dead or Love

title.native: 保安官エヴァンスの嘘～DEAD OR LOVE～
title.romaji: Hoankan Evans no Uso: Dead or Love

99370.description:
Revisit the tale of the faerie soldiers and their young instructor in these short stories featuring the three wielders of the most powerful dug weapon, Seniorious: Legal Brave Lillia Asplay, Chtholly Nota Seniorious, and Lakhesh. Although this virtuous white blade is drawn to wielders doomed to a fate of death and destruction, these girls never stopped yearning for a future they would never experience for themselves.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Do you have what THE END? Are you busy? Shall you save xxx? #EX
What are you doing at the end? Are you busy? Can you save me?
Tận thế nếu không bận, anh cứu chúng em nhé? #EX
